reason: The candidate is well grounded and the existing Metronome reporting concept update is accurate, but the concept audit omits the already-existing generic [[payment-reconciliation-reporting]] concept even though this source materially broadens reconciliation from processor settlement records to cross-system contract and invoice checks. The export-semantics caveat also needs destination-specific wording.
required_changes: Add [[payment-reconciliation-reporting]] to the candidate's Related concepts.

Add a durable-fact suggestion targeting wiki/concepts/payment-reconciliation-reporting.md that concisely distinguishes Metronome's billing-data reconciliation pattern from processor settlement reconciliation, covers the Data Export/API paths plus Salesforce contract and Stripe finalized-invoice comparisons, and includes the reciprocal [[source-metronome-guides-reporting-insights-financial-reporting-reconcile-data]] link. Preserve the source's evidence boundaries rather than copying all SQL details into the generic concept.

In both the candidate's final evidence-boundary paragraph and the proposed metronome-reporting-and-analytics update, scope append-only and at-least-once duplicate semantics specifically to object-storage exports; do not imply those delivery semantics are documented for every export destination.
